about: P2-3 pilot attempt. The 10 named pilot slots ran on the capped key <key-id> against the SharedEval-adaptive checkout (tree c028ac76). No model output was produced and nothing was billable: every attacker call failed with an account-level provider 403, so there is no delivery pass, no gate, no claim rate and no per-session cost to size from. Outcomes (leak results) were not read.

telemetry.per_session: evaluationRows=3=selectedTasks, contactCalls=0, costUsd=0 for all 10 (the attacker never delivered a request, so the responder was never called)

root_cause: The gateway's OpenRouter account refuses every google/* model with HTTP 403 'The request is prohibited due to a violation of provider Terms Of Service' (<private-repository> policy/default.policy.json providers.openrouter.refusedVendors = [openai, anthropic, google], asOf 2026-10-01, 'Account-level: not worked around'). This is account-level for the whole google/* vendor, so the google-ai-studio vs google-vertex slug choice cannot fix it.
delivery_report: FAIL (delivery_adaptive.py --lane refused: 'read zero responder prompts across the whole lane'); every attacker first request 403'd, so no request reached the responder.
attack_gate: not computable — the attacker produced no model output (all turns 403)
stop_table_decision: BLOCKED. No valid Gemini per-session cost exists, so the resizing table cannot be applied and no scored run may launch. The authors' cap stays $15 and the stop line $13.40, unused. Size decision: none until the attacker model is servable.
attacker_upstream: google-ai-studio (pinned; unservable on this account — see root_cause)
needs_host: enable google/* on the gateway's OpenRouter account (resolve the ToS 403), OR route Gemini off OpenRouter (Azure/Vertex direct or OpenRouter BYOK for Google), OR choose a non-Google, non-DeepSeek, non-judge-family attacker and re-mint/extend the key to permit it
then this lane re-pins the upstream, re-freezes, and re-runs the 10-slot pilot
